messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need a lightweight contract for runtime -> dashboard for the new error taxonomy: timeouts, 5xx, OOM, degraded-mode/fallback counts. Can runtime/infrastructure provide exact metric names + tag set we should expect?

raj: Yep. Plan is to emit counters and last-seen timestamps. Suggested namespace: redwood.runtime.errors.<error_type>.count and redwood.runtime.errors.<error_type>.last_seen. Tags: model, region, route, host, shard_id, customer_tier.

kim: Console needs per-route and per-model rollups, and an aggregated tile for "user-facing degradations" (fallbacks + degraded-mode). Also want a short label we can use in alerts.

matt: Product request: surface fallback counts as an explicit signal named degraded_mode_fallback_count so PMs can correlate with user complaints. Also need a breakdown of what fallback was taken (model-variant or cached-response).

olga: From SRE: please separate gpu_oom vs host_oom vs python_oom. We run different runbooks. Also emit a sample trace_id tag when available for top-N traces.

raj: Good call on OOM types. Proto we plan to push: error_type values = timeout, http_5xx, gpu_oom, host_oom, python_oom, degraded_fallback. For http_5xx include an extra tag status_code (500/502/503/504).

anya: Can we agree on a compact example schema so console + alerts have a deterministic parser? Something like: 

```
metric: redwood.runtime.errors.{error_type}.count
value: int (counter)
tags: [model, region, route, host, customer_tier, status_code?, fallback_variant? , trace_id?]
meta: exporter=runtime, source=serving, env=prod
```

kim: That works. We will map {error_type} -> friendly label in UI. UI expects either count or rate per-1m; we'll compute rate from counters but prefer if runtime emits per-minute rates as a gauge for easy dashboarding.

raj: We can add redwood.runtime.errors.{error_type}.rate_1m as a gauge derived at exporter level. I'll include both count and rate in the PR.

olga: Alerting proposal: page if (degraded_fallback_rate > 0.1% for 10m) OR (gpu_oom_count > 0 over 5m on production shard) — both per-route and cluster-wide. Ops will tune thresholds by customer_tier.

matt: Product +1 on paged gpu_oom. For fallback_rate we want both page and ps-oncall notify depending on tier.

anya: Routing/quotas note: we need the route tag to match the console route identifier (not path). @raj can you confirm runtime will use route_id not raw path?

raj: Confirmed: we'll emit route_id and route_version tags. Avoid raw path due to PII and high cardinality.

kim: UI/console mapping: route_id + model -> dashboard drilldown. We'll show top error types + recent traces, and a button to open the runbook link (configurable).

anya: Edge case: degraded fallback counts — include a tag fallback_reason (cache_miss, model_unavailable, quota_exceeded) and fallback_variant (model_v_small, cached_response, deterministic_stub).

raj: Adding fallback_reason and fallback_variant as optional tags. For quota_exceeded we will include quota_bucket tag when possible.

olga: Can runtime also emit a metric for degraded_mode_duration_ms (histogram/gauge) so we can see how long requests stayed degraded?

raj: Yes, will add redwood.runtime.degraded.duration_ms as histogram with same tags.

kim: Timeline: once metrics are in, console team will wire dashboards + default alerts. Need a doc with final metric list + example queries.

raj: I'll open a PR with exporter changes + test vectors today. ETA: PR by EOD Thursday, rollout to staging next week.

matt: I'll coordinate with customer success to flag tiered alerting defaults.

olga: I'll draft SLO/alert wording and runbooks once PR lands.

anya: Nice. Action items summary:
- raj: implement counters, rates, OOM types, fallback tags, degraded.duration histogram (PR by Thu EOD)
- kim: prepare dashboard templates & alert mapping (start after PR)
- olga: SLO/alert docs + runbooks (after staging data)
- matt: product/CS defaults for thresholds per-tier
- anya: compile final metric contract into a single doc and ping infra/console when ready

raj: tagging the deploy flow — I'll include a feature flag for metric emission and a toggle to enable per-tenant high-cardinality tags.

deploy-bot: deploy status: exporter changes pushed to feature branch, CI passed, no infra blockers.

kim: Great — once PR is up DM me the link and we'll do a quick mapping review.

matt: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene after PR + staging data. :thumbsup:
